missing_relations.assertion: Serum deprivation increased PTEN expression in H9c2 cells.
missing_relations.evidence: As a result, we observed that serum deprivation in H9c2 cells increased PTEN expression.

context.supporting_evidence: As a result, we observed that serum deprivation in H9c2 cells increased PTEN expression. Functionally, the PTEN knockdown experiment using siRNA inhibited serum deprivation-induced cell apoptosis, ROS production, and DNA damage, whereas increased cell proliferation.

effects.value: Reversal of the PTEN-knockdown-associated inhibition of cell apoptosis, ROS production, and DNA damage, and increase in cell proliferation.
effects.supporting_evidence: Functionally, the PTEN knockdown experiment using siRNA inhibited serum deprivation-induced cell apoptosis, ROS production, and DNA damage, whereas increased cell proliferation. All these effects could be reversed by phosphatidylinositol 3-kinase (PI3K) inhibitor
